Configuring the build cache

  1. Cache location
  2. Size limits
  3. Cleanup

Cache location

The build tool writes the cache to the project directory by default. Set the cache path option to move the cache to a faster disk. This is page 2 of 8 in the build guide.

Size limits

The cache grows until it reaches the size limit. The tool then removes the oldest entries first, so recent builds stay fast.

Cleanup

Run the clean command to remove every cache entry. Do this after you change the compiler version.
